trend.subtitle: Trend counts use authored_at inside the collection window only. This is not a live post-analysis trend.

research.key_findings: Across 901 search-related items, 617 carry an actionable pain point and 549 are negative about search. System Issues is the most cited overarching theme (341 items). The most common sub-themes are Search UI hard to navigate (146), Face not detected or grouped (126), Did not know search capability existed (107). Search types mentioned most often are People and Pets (194), Other (139), Date & Time (129).

sub_themes.name: Did not know search capability existed

top_suggestions.snippet: 5 years and counting! Tried again and it’s still an unorganized mess. Update: Just cancelled my subscription. Not giving any more money when feedback is being ignored across all Google products. 4 years and still no fix… There’s still no slider for recently added, only on the default homepage, which makes photos and videos I save from social media end up out of order.
Please add search functionality (search by file name) while adding photos in albums as in ios

Date grouping disappeared! I've been using Google Photos for years but recently an update removed the photos being grouped by date. Makes it much harder to organise and view my photos. Please bring back that view.
Dates I love the app but can you bring back the dates? When I would look up a face it would show the dates of the photos and divide them into it. But now it's all mixed together.
Bring back group by date. The new interface is stunning and gorgeous, but I really miss the option to group photos by the date they were taken.

research.suggestion_summary: The 5 highest-engagement suggestion snippets ask to restore date grouping, then improve people and face search, then add more result filters.

featured_snippets.snippet: Face grouping lost and can't find albums now? Basically I accidentally turned off face grouping like an idiot and lost everything from the beginning. I gave it a day to process them all again when I turned it on and started going through labeling the people.
The latest update is horrible. Photos used to have the most amazing AI search. The search in this version is HORRIBLE. You keep becoming more like Apple and iPhone every day

Features I need - Map view, exif level tagging Hey Folks, In general, I'm a fan of google photos, and use it heavily (10's of thousands of photos). The two things I run into on a regular basis that I really need to be able to do from my desktop/browser are: * The ability to look at a map view of my photos, which I can zoom into at a similar resolution that you can get with google maps.
A piece of garbage. Dumps all the photos into one giant, disorganized pile, making it impossible to properly find my SORTED BY FOLDERS photos.
google photos not doing facial recognition on faces that I manually tag Community Google Photos on... Community Google Photos on...
. Would love if app layout could go back to monthly sections as photos are so hard to find now that they are all cluttered together which makes the app much harder to use
the face recognition feature was not turned off, it's still not grouping
Pls provide a "SEARCH OPTION" while adding photos/videos into an album so that i don't have to scroll for long time to search the particular album.
